features.title: Manage reusable prompt snippets
features.summary: Save, edit, delete, search, and insert bounded prompt snippets with revision checks across browser tabs.
failureModes: Quota or storage failure leaves the prior library intact.
A cross-tab revision conflict preserves the local edit and offers save-as-copy.

verification.testName: refuses to overwrite a prompt changed in another browser tab
keeps the stored prompt when another tab changes it before deletion
rejects oversized text and duplicate prompt identities

features.title: Insert prompt text without submitting
features.summary: Insert into the captured composer cursor span, preserve existing attachments, and reject stale composer state without sending the message.
failureModes: A changed composer revision rejects insertion and asks the user to reopen the action.
Repeated insertion from one opening is ignored.

features.title: Browse recent text-only user messages
features.summary: Offer bounded recent loaded user text while excluding agent, tool, archived, and unsupported content.
failureModes: A message no longer present in loaded chat cannot be inserted.
Attachment and non-user content are never represented as plain prompt text.

verification.testName: keeps newest user text in reverse order and excludes attachments and non-user messages
ignores malformed rows and mismatched event anchors
deduplicates stable node identities and bounds the visible history

features.title: Save and restore composer drafts
features.summary: Save bounded plain-text drafts and restore sent text without submitting or converting attachments and references.
failureModes: Busy, empty, oversized, or reference-bearing input disables draft save.
Invalid storage falls back without overwriting the stored bytes.

verification.testName: rejects a draft when the composer is busy, empty, too large, or contains non-text data
ignores malformed, oversized, duplicate-id, and over-capacity stores
reads only bounded plain-text user messages
